specificFindings: Parasite family wealth and employment direction remain distinct:poor Kims,wealthy Parks,both families a son and daughter,and four Kim members work for the Parks. Discovering rich lives is not proof the Kims become wealthy.
Nice and naive contrasts with the rich-as-savvy-and-calculating stereotype. The novel-specific contrast is not an empirical assertion that every rich person is naive or every poor person incompetent.
Mr Kim uses rich but still nice as a contrast. Ms Kims Not rejects that relation; because in the next unit supplies her proposed cause. Speakers and cross-unit quotation attribution remain separate.

The because line is a causal assertion within fictional dialogue,not a verified population effect. If I had...Id is counterfactual and too extends the hypothetical comparison,not receipt of the Parks money.
The Kant distinction is beautiful versus pleasant arts in the cited Critique of Judgment. It is a source-attributed philosophical classification,not a new experiment or a film-duration rule.

Although devoid of definite purpose yet furthers retains the concession and mental-cultivation claim. Lack of definite practical purpose is not absence of value,and pleasant-arts time-passing is not substituted for beautiful art.

Rollins is identified as a jazz saxophonist. Evoked Kantian judgement is an association in the authors introduction,not proof Rollins literally quotes Kant or performed a controlled trial. Technology no saviour is not expanded into every technology having no use.

Art is the antecedent of Its infinite after Art is the exact opposite. Infinite and the world-without-art phrase remain the speakers artistic reflection,not a physical or economic infinity measurement.
Immaterial in immaterial soul concerns nonphysical intuition and feeling,not unimportance. The quotation is not presented as a scientific discovery of an entity.

Outlives the contentious political veneer gives the quoted reason for importance; it is not support for every political faction or a new measured art-survival study. Today remains within the books quoted view.
Echoes means Brooks has a resonating point,not literal audio replay,plagiarism or independent causal replication. The essay title and speaker are attributed exactly as in the actual PDF.

So countermeasures responds to Brooks own excessive political entanglement. Trying and I flee describe an attempt and metaphorical turn of attention,not guaranteed recovery,clinical treatment,physical migration or universal disengagement instruction.

Not just reading novels and poems but also looking at art extends opportunities rather than excluding reading. New experience is distinguished from acquiring a new fact in the surrounding Brooks quotation.
The author is reminded of Heideggers Das Gerede by the two views. It is a stated association,not joint authorship,an asserted direct quotation by Rollins/Brooks or an acoustic experiment.

Understanding everything without thinking deeply is read in the surrounding critique of gossip and obscuring importance. It does not certify total knowledge or equate superficial familiarity with independent reflection.
Constant possibility is ongoing susceptibility,not proof of actual distraction in every person at every instant. Bombarded is metaphorical here,not literal warfare or a diagnosis.
Social media and small talk are parallel examples in the authors discussion. No word-count study,exclusive online location rule or empirical all-conversation-worthlessness law is invented.

Uprooted,groundless,floating follow makes life feel and convey a psychological metaphor,not loss of property,physical levitation or a medical condition. Groundless here differs from the unsupported-accusation sense.
For me and rare moments restrict the personal benefit of arts and sports. The final evidence quotes are exact individual targets,so future painting-experience candidate IDs remain pending.

The final target names Mark Rothko before the No abbreviation split. Its question tests only the explicitly present painter attribution. Full parent passage and translation preserve No13 and the visceral-experience continuation as context,without falsely adding that pending candidate to direct evidence.
